investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lumtrel Trips (travel booking); Platform: AWS eu-west-1 (zones eu-west-1a/eu-west-1b/eu-west-1c); network range 10.76.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster lumtre-prod-euwest (EKS); Edge: provider-managed load balancer (edge-lb) in front of booking-web backends; a standby load balancer exists in a secondary region; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
